svg.title: Common cause, mediator, and collider
svg.desc: Common cause C points to training T and passing Y. A mediator M lies on T to Y. A collider S receives arrows from T and Y. Each role requires a different adjustment argument.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,98%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: What role does the third variable play?
Arrows state assumptions. The adjustment choice depends on the target.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(0%,47%,30%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(9%,9%,7%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(44%,34%,72%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(44%,34%,72%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(44%,34%,72%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,47%,30%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Account for C to block this backdoor path.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(0%,47%,30%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,47%,30%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: For the total effect, do not block the route through M.

g.text: Conditioning on S can open a noncausal path.
